selectionRule.onlyExcluded: Existing three-digit numeric immediate-child directories under Docs/Evidence other than 070 and 071, including each excluded directory entry and descendants.
explicitlyRetained: all other tracked files and directory entries

scope: Local archive bytes, namespace, CRC, SHA-256, original raw ZIP mode/type, actual immutable Git blob/tree identity and all 704 frozen runtime inputs. This does not add native play, visual, commercial completeness or remote Drive byte verification.
metadataLimits: The original Git ZIP has implicit normal-file and directory mode fields (raw mode 0); these original ZIP attributes are preserved and actual Git tree modes are explicit per tracked path. Symlink payloads would be copied as raw stored text without dereferencing; this commit contains zero symlinks. ACLs, xattrs and resource forks are not claimed. Compression representation and ZIP64 local fields may differ.
historicalEvidenceRetention: Excluded old numeric evidence is omitted only from this transport profile. It remains in the immutable private Git commit/history, the unchanged complete local source.zip and previously delivered private Drive history; this run makes no new remote presence or download verification claim.
